rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=2, lr=0.01, epochs=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, seed=42, rationale=wu_2015_trainable iter-4 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). CONFIRMATION / TERMINAL-LEVER iter. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) PRIOR TRAJECTORY: iter-1 = SSIM 0.8370 / hr 0.0508, 8 params (wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, ep6, lr0.01), elapsed 335s -- this is the BEST config. iter-2 = SSIM 0.8390 / hr 0.0337, 8 params (SAME but ep18), elapsed 866.6s -- epochs INERT (val_ssim +0.0020 within noise, hr FELL); the under-training falsifier FIRED. iter-3 = SSIM 0.8273 / hr 0.0, 10 params (wu_n_bands 4->6, ep6), elapsed 358s -- frequency-band capacity++ REGRESSED below the iter-1/2 baseline; the iter-3 falsifier FIRED (capacity bumps DESTABILISE these few-param FBP-family denoisers, matching dd_bilateral img_n_bf 3->6 0.9192->0.9057 and hammernik filters-up that same tick). (2) FAILURE MODE: few-param tuned-FBP ceiling (~hr 0.05). Wu-trainable is a band-reweighted aliasing-free FBP + soft-thresholded dense-residual pass(es) with NO image-domain CNN denoiser; epochs are inert and frequency-band count++ destabilises -- it sits hr~0.04-0.05 just above the LD-FBP floor and neither lever has moved it up. (3) ONE KNOB: wu_n_outer 1->2 (the SINGLE untried capacity lever). I revert wu_n_bands 6->4 to RESTORE the iter-1 BEST config (NOT iter-3's regressed 6 bands), and change ONLY wu_n_outer. This adds a SECOND outer soft-thresholded dense-residual denoising pass (solver forward() loop `for it in range(self.n_outer)`, lines 214-237: each pass = forward_project residual -> feature-preserving interp -> dense FBP -> per-outer soft-threshold -> per-outer learnable blend). It is the LAST structural capacity Wu offers that is orthogonal to the already-falsified epochs/n_bands levers, and it adds image-domain residual-correction depth rather than FBP frequency partitioning. NEW PARAM COUNT: wu_n_bands+2+2*wu_n_outer = 4+2+2*2 = 10 trainable scalars (was 8 at iter-1; iter-3's 6-band/1-outer was also 10) -- the +2 over iter-1 are the per-outer log_soft_thresh + residual_blend for the new second pass. BUDGET JUSTIFICATION: campaign_state flagged wu_n_outer=1 as a 'mandatory' HINT precisely because the 2x-dense-projector residual pass is the DOMINANT per-slice cost and n_outer=2 DOUBLES it. This is the ONE modest n_outer test the budget allows: sized at the iter-1 ep6 anchor (335s at n_outer=1). The doubled residual pass roughly doubles per-sample train+val cost vs iter-1 -> worst-case ~2x335 = ~670s for the dense pass + the band-FBP (unchanged at 4 bands) -> well under the 1200s 20-min budget and the 1800s SLURM kill, with the val FIGURE outside the budget. ep6 is correct: iter-2 PROVED ep6==ep18 (0.837 vs 0.839), so ep6 isolates wu_n_outer as the sole meaningful change AND keeps the doubled-residual run inside the wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if a second outer residual-denoising pass buys real image-domain headroom, iter-4 hr rises measurably above the iter-1 best 0.0508 (SSIM > 0.842, >+0.005 over the noise band). FALSIFIER (terminal): if hr <= 0.051 (at/below the iter-1 best) OR SSIM REGRESSES/stays FLAT, then epochs (inert), frequency bands (regressed), AND outer residual depth (this iter) have ALL failed to lift hr -- Wu-trainable is STRUCTURALLY FBP-ceilinged on Mayo regardless of its capacity knobs. File that verdict: the few-param tuned-FBP family caps at hr~0.05 on real-helical Mayo, far below the dual-domain U-Net families (hr~0.27), because it lacks an image-domain learned denoiser. (5) HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score budget, sized via the ep6 anchor with the n_outer=2 doubling accounted for above; val = ALL 214 L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard -- the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise); bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override). (6) no control return.
